name: @tedix/widget
description: Framework-neutral, white-label embedded tedi widget for customer applications.

scripts.dev: bun run build:assets && bun run clear-port && bun ../../scripts/dev-local.ts -- vp dev
scripts.build:assets: bun build src/embed/embed.mjs --outfile public/embed.js --target browser --format iife --banner '/* oxlint-disable -- generated bundle; lint src/embed/embed.mjs and imported packages */' && bun build src/embed/confirm.mjs --outfile public/confirm.js --target browser --format esm --banner '/* oxlint-disable -- deferred portable-write confirmation */' && bun build src/loader.mjs --outfile public/loader.js --target browser --format iife --banner '/* oxlint-disable -- generated bundle; lint src/loader.mjs */' && vp fmt public/embed.js public/confirm.js public/loader.js && bun scripts/version-embed.ts
scripts.deploy:production: bun run types && bun run build:assets && vp build --mode production && cf deploy --mode production --prebuilt --message ${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}}
scripts.type-check: bun run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.dom-test.json
